pan.approvals: 2026-11-26, by the user: 2 tries beyond the brief's two retakes, then 3 more, then 3 tries with the text "Pan!" (brief §4.3: at most two retakes per item unless the user approves more)
pan.why: Chosen by the team by ear on 2026-11-26 from six candidates on a local listening page: the vowel and /n/ of try 3 (heard as "pan") after the natural /p/ burst and aspiration of try 2 (same voice and text), from the processed tries. Whisper "small" heard most tries and candidates with a clearly aspirated /p/ as "pun" or "pum" (all three "Pan!" tries in 15 of 15 runs), and its answer for such clips changes with small differences and from run to run (this one: "pan" in 10 of 10 runs while choosing), so the choice was left to the ear.
